meta.name: muapi-ugc-video-factory
meta.description: Turn a person photo + a product photo + an optional script into a vertical 9:16 UGC-style video ad. Generates a lifestyle hero image (Nano-Banana Pro Edit), then animates it with native audio using Seedance 2.0 VIP image-to-video.

copy.tagline: 将人物和产品照片转为竖屏UGC风格视频广告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速生成真人感的产品推广视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn person and product photos into vertical UGC-style video ads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate authentic-looking product promo videos.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 根据你提供的人物照片、产品照片和可选台词，生成一段9:16竖屏的UGC风格视频广告。视频中人物会自然使用产品并说出台词。
howto.when: 当你提到“ugc video factory”、“ugc video ad”、“person plus product video”等关键词，或要求制作产品推荐视频时触发。

say.text: 帮我用这张人物照和产品照做一个UGC视频广告。
say.note: 需要先上传人物和产品照片。

say.text: 生成一个戴帽子的人推荐帽子的竖屏视频。
say.note: 指定了可穿戴产品，视频中人物会戴上帽子。

howto.what_en: Turns a person photo, a product photo, and an optional script into a vertical 9:16 UGC-style video ad. The video shows the person naturally using the product and speaking the script.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "ugc video factory", "ugc video ad", "person plus product video", or ask to create a product recommendation video.

say_en.text: Create a UGC video ad using this person photo and product photo.
say_en.note: Upload person and product photos first.

say_en.text: Generate a vertical video of a person wearing a hat and recommending it.
say_en.note: Specifies a wearable product; the person will wear the hat.
